newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering eyes higher Betaferon sales in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Schering eyes higher Betaferon sales in 1997.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Wednesday that is expects sales in its multiple sclerosis drug Betaferon to rise by over 10 percent to 590 million marks ($352.3 million) this year.
"We expect that we will reach worldwide sales of 590 million marks with Betaferon," Schering management board chairman Giuseppe Vita said.
Vita made this prediction despite expected competition from U.S. group Biogen's Avonex product, which will be launched in Europe in the next weeks.
Sales of Betaferon, sold as Betaseron in the U.S. where it was an unrivalled product for several years, totalled 533 million marks in 1996, topping 1996 sales estimates of 530 million marks.
Vita said Schering was currently testing whether Betaferon could also be used to treat certain other illnesses.
